newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to release Cemig bid specs Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to release Cemig bid specs Friday.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank unit BNDESPar is likely to release on Feb 21 tender documents to sell off debentures convertible to Minas Gerais state power firm Cemig common shares, Gazeta Mercantil reported.
No BNDESPar and Cemig officials would confirm the report.
According to Gazeta, the debentures will be convertible to 32.9 percent of Cemig's common stock, or 18.7 billion shares, and were likely to be put at a block sale in the second week of April.
It said the face value of the debentures would total 560 million reais. Cemig has a net worth of 8.6 billion reais, it added.
